title: Agentic cheminformatics: new macrocycles from literature analysis
summary: An agent using Cheminformatics Skills for Antigravity collected thousands of compounds analogous to crizotinib and lorlatinib, analyzed 568, and proposed new rigidified macrocycles with synthesis routes in about an hour. The proposals are computational hypotheses that still need to be synthesized and validated.

evidence.tested: The source describes computational evaluation only: benchmarks of several machine learning architectures on four readouts with scaffold splits, and predicted potency; no synthesis or experimental validation is reported.
evidence.unknown: Every proposed design must still be synthesized and validated; the data are sparse and assay noise is high; the designs are testable hypotheses, not finished drugs.
evidence.ai_role: An agent searched literature for crizotinib and lorlatinib analogues, curated 568 compounds, ran matched molecular pair analysis, benchmarked models, and proposed macrocycles and synthesis routes.
